paragraphs: R' Paltiya of Naveh. (Pelatiah; the source cites I Chronicles 4:44.) Mentioned in Kohelet Rabbah 1:5; R' Shmuel reported in his name.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ד״ה א׳ פ״ד-מד reads I Chronicles chapter 4 verse 44, not a range 42–44. The named Miqra according to the Masorah text has Pelatiah at I Chronicles 4:42. The source’s 4:44 remains explicit; no claim is made about how the difference arose or which printed mark should replace it.

פלטיא and פלטיה remain distinct as Paltiya and Pelatiah. Of Naveh is a lexical epithet without a fresh place identification. קה״ר פ״א-ה is read as Kohelet Rabbah chapter 1 section 5, without independently checking that locus. Shmuel reports Paltiya, not the reverse; both title abbreviations remain R'.
